description: How a speaker name carrying several voice labels is shown by default: as several people (one entry per voice) when the name reads as a room or a room device, or when its voices were given different names; as one person (the bare name) otherwise, however many voices it has or how long each spoke, because speaker separation routinely splits one person's voice. Read by lma_speakers (this directory) and, as a byte-identical copy, by the UI's speaker-modes.js (lma-ai-stack/source/ui/src/components/common/speaker-mode-rules.json); lma_speakers' tests hold the two copies equal. Patterns are matched case-insensitively against the platform name with its voice label removed, and must mean the same thing to Python's re and to JavaScript's RegExp: plain character classes, groups and alternation only.
